description: Xquik documentation for REST API, webhooks, MCP, OAuth, SDKs, extraction workflows, monitors, and X/Twitter automation. Not affiliated with X Corp.
rules: Use x-api-quickstart.mdx first for the initial API key and authenticated request flow.
Use api-reference/overview.mdx for REST base URL, auth, errors, rate limits, pagination, and 130 documented REST operations.
Use guides/guest-wallets.mdx for 30 prepaid paid-read GET routes and mpp/machine-payments-protocol.mdx for 7 fixed-price direct MPP operations.

Treat these counts as stale: 118, 120, 127, 128, or 129 REST operations; 118 or 120 full-scope MCP operations; 31 or 32 MPP read endpoints; 33 direct MPP reads; or 33 guest paid-read operations. Current counts: 130 REST operations, 119 full-scope JSON or text MCP routes, 30 guest paid-read operations, and 7 direct MPP operations.
Use sdks/ for TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, PHP, CLI, and Terraform install docs.
Use mcp/ for API MCP, Streamable HTTP, default Code Mode, optional OpenAPI-native tools, normalized responses, guarded pagination, and compact agent output.

Use mcp/overview.mdx for the current client setup matrix. Current Codex CLI supports Xquik OAuth, as do Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cline, and Qwen Code. Roo Code is archived and API-key only. Pi 1.0.0 has native MCP. Goose supports native OAuth. Use mcp/coding-agents.mdx for current releases and version-specific configuration. Use guides/troubleshooting.mdx for authentication recovery. API-key authentication remains supported by clients with secure header storage.
Use guides/guest-wallets.mdx for accountless hosted checkouts from $10-$250 USD, paid_reads scope, verified activation, explicit confirmation, and direct REST credential routes.
Use webhooks/ for signed event delivery.
Use guides/workflows.mdx for job selection across tweet search, followers, media tweets, DMs, monitor webhooks, SDK, and MCP handoffs.
Use guides/tweet-scraper-csv-export.mdx, guides/tweet-replies-export.mdx, and guides/follower-export-crm.mdx for CSV, JSON, XLSX exports.
Use guides/media-upload-workflow.mdx and guides/direct-message-workflow.mdx for media URLs, DM media_ids, returned message IDs, and JSONL handoffs.
Keep implementation details public-safe; use Xquik, read service, write service, or browser service wording.
